text:
ellie: Quick note: onboarding sampleapp webhook sometimes gets duplicate completion events when auth refresh + 429 happen mid-stream. Minimal repro in a sec.

noah: can you paste a log snippet?

ellie: logs:
2024-08-21T10:12:01Z start req=aa1
2024-08-21T10:12:02Z auth:refresh req=aa1
2024-08-21T10:12:02Z http 429 req=aa1
2024-08-21T10:12:03Z retry req=aa1
2024-08-21T10:12:03Z webhook POST /events id=evt-9 status=200
2024-08-21T10:12:04Z webhook POST /events id=evt-9 status=200 (duplicate)

sam: root cause seems to be SDK recreating outbound requests and dropping transient metadata (no replay id).

noah: proposal: SDK generates X-Redwood-Replay at start and preserves it across retries. Sampleapp mirrors to X-Idempotency-Key when posting to consumer.

sam: also use decorrelated jitter for 429 backoff and prefer resume-with-offset when possible instead of full retry.

ellie: I'll open a small PR to add replay-id exposure in Node+Python SDKs and update sampleapp docs. CI flake job linked: https://ci.example.com/2101

ci-bot: ci: job 2101 shows flaky webhook e2e failing intermittently.
